capabilities: Import a Jot export file into the vault
Map each Jot category to a chosen note and heading
Save the export's photos and files from .zip exports
Watch a Jots folder and offer to import new exports
extras: Warns about a Sync conflict: if you use Obsidian Sync, import on one device at a time and wait for Sync to finish, or notes can be merged with duplicated jots. The plugin makes no network requests and needs Obsidian 1.13 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring in exports from the Jot capture app, including their photos and files, into the notes you pick.

relations.evidence: Jot is a private capture app for iPhone. Jot Import brings Jot exports into your Obsidian vault.

summary: Imports Jot export files from the Jot iPhone capture app into vault notes, routing each Jot category to a note and heading you choose.
